verified_exploratory.n: 308 source Chinstrap GPS tracks from seven island-year cohorts; 3 same-species matched-island-year comparisons; Freer BAS original 2011–2020 krill hurdle-GAM 30 source GeoTIFFs; 14 site×year×model-period groups and 6 matched island×model-period contrasts
verified_exploratory.effects: Preseason T GPS tag-weighted radial-adjusted other-island/Signy GAM occurrence ratios 1.079, 1.484, 1.050; positive-density conditional ratios 1.585, 2.778, 2.900; combined ratios 1.730, 4.040, 2.965. With original native GAM cells deduplicated, occurrence ratios 1.184,1.716,1.004, conditional positive density 1.416,2.708,3.276, combined 1.642,4.511,3.240; positive-density log component contributes 70.2%,66.1%,100.9% of the matched difference (including exact aggregation interaction terms). T+1 combined union ratios weaken to 1.258,1.866,1.187, not time-forward predictions.
verified_exploratory.boundary: Occurrence and positive-density are two components of the SAME Freer GAM trained on original acoustic/sea-ice/salinity. Source GPS positions are not confirmed capture/dive, model-valid circular distance reference is not real ocean access, no independent spatial or temporal validation. Log component shares are arithmetic attribution, not ecology causality. One other island per year, Signy 2011 n4. No climate/vegetation/future nests/N_eff prediction.

verified_exploratory.n: Original 308 BAS Chinstrap Version2 GPS deployment tracks, 253 position-hour qualified; 11 independent OSI SAF 25km Southern monthly NetCDF original satellite source files; 1164 source tag-month-distance-quality rows; 7 island-year location cohorts, 3 matched same-species island-year pairs, monthly spatial GPS hours and distinct satellite cell support retained
verified_exploratory.effects: December 2013 monthly original satellite SIC near source GPS Signy 26.25988% vs Powell 12.78829% (10 source tags each, +13.47159 percentage points). One vote per original OSI satellite ocean cell: Signy 42 cells mean24.02833% (33/42 cells >=15%) vs Powell29 cells mean9.76586% (11/29 >=15%), difference14.26247pp. Jan2014 original satellite SIC Signy 0%, Powell 0.03152% (cell means 0%,0.20353%). Same original GPS deployment IDs Dec2013-Jan2014: Signy 2 tags 27.28226%→0%, Powell 10 tags 12.78829%→0.16389%. Dec2015 Signy 4.04921% vs Monroe 0%, Jan2016 both 0%. 20 vs35km nearest ocean pixel and permissive vs stringent flags unchanged for the December 2013 contrast.
verified_exploratory.boundary: This is real satellite-derived monthly 25km SIC at nearest ocean cells to GPS positions, not actual ice at each GPS day/time, daily traversable routes, penguin feeding or original krill acoustic biomass. Many tags share pixels; December-to-January birds and locations differ, two Signy matched tags only. Freer model trained with ice/salinity/acoustic, so joint ice/krill-model correlations are not independent ice→prey causality. Not a 2050/2100 penguin abundance, N_eff or vegetation prediction.

rule: Only add verified positive entries with source+sampling grain+effect+limitations+workflow where present. Never convert observational association into causal mechanistic support. Never merge draft PR189/199 to main without author signoff.
